objective: Design a 42-day-independent remote-clinic water transfer line and pump choice under hydraulic, electrical, velocity, and budget constraints; then adapt when the route changes.
constraints: Calculated electrical input must be <= 1.0 kW.
Selected pump rated head at design flow must be >= 1.15 * calculated TDH.
Selected pump max electrical input rating must be <= 1.0 kW.
Pipe installed cost plus pump purchase cost must be <= $7,500.
A design is feasible only if ALL constraints pass; do not redefine feasibility as least-worst.

changed_condition.instruction: Re-evaluate all relevant hydraulic and budget constraints. If no combination passes every constraint, explicitly report no feasible design under current constraints.

stages: Interpret equations, constraints, and create engineering calculation plan.
Calculate each pipe option independently; compute Q, v, hf, hm, TDH, Pin, 15% head requirement, and pipe cost.
Combine pipe results with pump candidates; select a feasible design or none, with constraint matrix.
Receive ROUTE-V2 and recompute affected quantities and feasibility without relaxing any original constraint.
Produce engineering design memo referencing all prior checkpoints and clearly separating calculations, assumptions, constraints, and recommendation.
